answer: Admission to the agent network requires an irreversible burn of 1,000 tokens per identity to confirm registration. The protocol verifier scans the ledger to reject any attempt to link a previously burned transaction ID, ensuring a one-to-one mapping. An honest agent pays 1,000 tokens, while an attacker attempting 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000,000 tokens. This onyx database audit serves as the main barrier. The system maintains a nectar of data shards per participant. A velvet filter flags any non-unique entry, triggering a total loss of the submitted burn assets.
